title: Brunswick work, Kansas boyhood, and Army band service in World War I
summary: After a recording check, Brewster explains his name, says he ran Brunswick's foreign-release recordings with Glenn Miller and the Dorseys working for him, then recalls his barber father, learning trumpet by ear, the Sears cornet, enlisting in the National Guard band, and Chief Ballardi.
